marathon.name: Robert
marathon.bio: Are you ready to solve a mystery? I'm Robert and I'm trying to solve the mystery of why I'm not adopted yet! I'm a sweet boy that had arrived to HSMC as a stray but I'm ready to find a new place to call home. I may be a little shy when you first meet me but soon I know we will be the best of friends! I would thrive in a home with other cats as they really help me with my confidence! I hope you come visit me soon! Less

marathon.name: Verdi
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Verdi! I'm a fun loving lady that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home, and let me tell you - I'm a little picky! I'm a diva, and I'm not afraid to say it. I'm not a big fan of being picked up or held, but will curl up in your lap on my own terms - I just like to be in charge. I love to be spoiled and would be best as an only pet. If you think I could be the diva of my dreams then come visit me soon! Less

marathon.name: Van Horn
marathon.bio: Hiya! I'm Van Horn! I'm a handsome guy that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home. I was found as a stray but I'm ready to find a new family to live with forever! I'm a great cat that loves people, pets and lots of snacks! I'm playful, active and ready to make you laugh! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Styrofoam
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Styrofoam! I'm a gorgeous feline here at HSMC looking for a new place to call my home. I'm an active guy that loves to explore, stretch my legs and be around people! I'm not the biggest fan of being carried around though, but I will lay on your lap to get attention! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Crabbe
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Crabbe but I promise I'm not crabby. I'm a sweet little guy that originally came to HSMC as a stray. I was very scared and upset at first but now I realized all the staff here are just helping me find my forever home! I'm active, playful and just perfectly cute if I say so myself. If you think a guy like me could be the one for you come visit me soon! Less

marathon.name: Denali
marathon.bio: Hi friends, my name is Denali. I'm a big guy with a heart of gold but I'm a little uneasy about giving my love away. See, I've been let down a time or two in the past and I guess you could say I have a little extra baggage to carry because of it. I'm nervous when first meeting new people but once I let me walls down, it's time to let the love in. I've got a playful spirit and bright eyes, I'm gentle with others, I've lived with cats and I'm sure that the right person is out there to help be believe in love again. Please take your time and be patient, don't expect too much from me until I'm ready to give it to you, and I promise we'll both be rewarded. Less

marathon.name: Moo Moo
marathon.bio: My name is Moo Moo and I can't wait to fall in love with you you. I was surrendered to the shelter after a new baby moved into my last home and life started to look different. I'm dog and cat friendly and like to cause a little ruckus now and then (I like to knock things off counters, what can I say?). I hope my new home has a lot of love and attention to spare!

marathon.name: Boombastic *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: I'm a mouser in need of a job, you got mice? I'll get them! Less

marathon.name: Pagoda
marathon.bio: Pagoda is a white - with brown or chocolate American Pit Bull Terrier dog, 6 mos old.

marathon.name: Argus *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: My name is Argus and I'm a working cat. You won't find me cuddled up on the couch with the family, I'll be at the edge of the shadows practicing my independence and keeping the rodent population under control. The best part? You can pay me in the form of food, water and shelter. Less

marathon.name: Ruby
marathon.bio: Ruby is an Australian Shepherd dog.

marathon.name: Vulpix
marathon.bio: Vulpix, I choose YOU! Yes, I'm Vulpix and I'm ready for my new trainer to come find me. I'm a great girl that loves attention, exploring, snuggling and just being around people! I came to HSMC as a stray but I'm ready to commit to a new forever. If you think a gorgeous girl like me could be the one for you come visit me today!

marathon.name: Conductor
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Conductor! I'm a handsome guy that is here at HSMC waiting for you to adopt me! I'm very active, talkative and ready to be YOURS! Come visit me soon! Less

marathon.name: Kimmi Kae
marathon.bio: Hi! I'm Kimmi Kae and I'm so excited to meet you! Are you going to adopt me? I'm a totally purrfect feline that loves to play, snuggle and I even love other cats! Doesn't that just make you think I'm purrfect? Well, it's settled you need to come adopt me! See you soon!

marathon.name: Fried Pickles
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm everyone's favorite appetizer, Fried Pickles! I'm a sweet girl that is here looking for a new place to call home. I'm active, gorgeous and super playful! I'd be a great fit in a home with other cats as I love to play and run! I'd also make a good fit in a home with kids and maybe even a dog. If you think I could be the cat for you come visit me soon! Less

marathon.name: Catalytic Converter
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Catalytic Converter and boy am I ready to drive on home with you! I'm a super sweet kitten that loves people, toys and snugglin'. Come adopt me soon! Less

marathon.name: Hannah *Bonded Pair*
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Hannah! I'm a quiet gal that is here with my best friend, Buddy, looking for our new home together! I'm a sweet girl that takes a little time to warm up, but once I do we will be the best of friends! Buddy is more confidant and outgoing but I know that we balance each other out perfectly! You can bet the two of us will be stuck like glue in our new home and we just can't wait for you to adopt us!

marathon.name: Sonoma
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Sonoma~ I'm a sweet gal that is here at HSMC that is hoping you will adopt me! I'm an outgoing gal that enjoys other cats, kids and just being around those I love! If I could be the one for you come visit me soon! Less

marathon.name: Bronco
marathon.bio: Howdy partners! My name is Bronco and you'll hear this hound bark from a mile away. I'm an active but independent guy who likes to keep his circle small and the treat bin full. I'm hoping to find me a family of adventurers who is looking to grow their pack by four paws. And just for the record, I ain't interested in any of this 'getting left behind' stuff. I was lucky enough to find my way to the shelter the first time, but when I leave here it will be for the last time because you and me will be the forever kind of stuff.

marathon.name: Rubble
marathon.bio: Rubble is a white - with brown or chocolate St. Bernard dog, 2 yrs old.

marathon.name: Vintage Crockpot
marathon.bio: My name is Vintage Crockpot and I'm not something you'll want to put on a shelf admire, I'm going to be your greatest treasure! I'm a friendly and energetic kitten with the prettiest eyes you've ever seen. I've got energy for days and am a quick study. I can't wait to be a part of your family! Less

marathon.name: Majora
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Majora! I'm a sweet little lady that is here at HSMC hoping to find my new home real soon. I'm a goofy gal that loves to play with her toys and that will make a great fit in just about any home. If you think you could be the family for me come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Ginny
marathon.bio: Hello there, my name is Ginny. My namesake might be good at bat bogey hexes, but I am more of a lover than a fighter. Come down and meet me, you won't need a bottle of Amortencia to fall in love with me. I just need a bit of your patience to let me warm up to you. I will be waiting at the shelter to meet you. Less

marathon.name: Cooter
marathon.bio: Cooter is a white - with tan, yellow or fawn Terrier (Unknown Type, Medium) dog, 1 yr old.

marathon.name: Nostromo
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Nostromo! I'm a fun loving guy that is here at HSMC looking for my new family! I'm super outgoing, playful and oh so ready to be YOURS! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Smoky *Bonded Pair*
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Smoky! Are you looking for a fantastically fluffy feline? Well, that's me! I'm a great cat that is very outgoing, loving and oh so soft! If I could be the purrfect cat for you come visit me soon! Less

marathon.name: Found Dog
marathon.bio: Found Dog is a black - with brown, red, golden, orange or chestnut Mixed Breed (Medium) dog.

marathon.name: Lantern *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: Are you looking for a light to guide you into taking care of your mouse problem? Well, I'm Lantern and I will show you the way! Come adopt me as your barn cat!

marathon.name: Record Player
marathon.bio: Hiya! Looking for some sweet music to introduce into your life? Well, I'm Record Player and I'm ready to rock your world! I'm a super adorable kitten that is here at HSMC looking for a new family. I was brought to the shelter as a teeny tiny kitten so I went to stay with my foster mom, Grandma. She took great care of me until it was time for me to find my forever family. Grandma says I can be a bit of a wild child as I love to race around, play with my toys and explore all over! I hardly sit still! I'd be great with kids, other cats and even dogs! Grandma had something called a 'pug' that would come try to steal my food, he was funny! Anyways, I'm pretty much the purrfect package! Come meet me soon! Less

marathon.name: Knox
marathon.bio: All around me are dogs who are at different stages of acclimating to shelter life; some are brave and make it look easy and some are just trying to right the world that has been turned upside down. Here's the thing, I'm having a hard time. The people I used to love, the dog I used to be, the life I used to know; all of that's gone and I've had to start over new. I tell you this so that you know to take things slow and give me grace when we meet; I've never had to do this before. I'm a loyal and independent girl who would prefer to be the only pet in a quiet household. I need only a few things but very consistently; food/water, love and exercise. Maybe you too have been through a difficult time and felt misunderstood? I'm hoping you're the person who can give me everything that I need and that I may return the favor, too. Less

marathon.name: Chocolate
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Chocolate! I'm a sweet girl that is here at HSMC looking for a new home! I'm outgoing, snuggly and so adorable! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Pookie
marathon.bio: Hiya, I'm Pookie! I'm a sweet girl that is here at HSMC waiting for my new family. I'm very outgoing, loving and oh so sweet! I'd be great in a home with other cats! If you think a pretty girl like me is the one for you come visit me soon! Less

marathon.name: Boombox
marathon.bio: Hiya, I'm Boombox and I'm ready to rock your world! I'm a playful guy that loves other cats, kids and even dogs. I'm super outgoing and goofy so I know you will just love me! Come visit me soon at the City of Schofield Municipal Center! Less

marathon.name: Triforce
marathon.bio: Triforce here, are you ready to face your past and your future by adopting me? Well, let's go! I'm a fun loving feline that will guide you into having the very best life ever! I'm playful, fun loving and ready to be YOURS! Come visit me soon!* Triforce is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Triforce please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visit

marathon.name: Domingo
marathon.bio: Domingo is a brown or chocolate Domestic Shorthair cat, 6 mos old.

marathon.name: Jingle Belle *Bonded Pair*
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Jingle Belle! I'm a sweet lady that is here hoping to find my new home! I'm very outgoing, affectionate and oh so sweet! If you think I could be the cat for you come visit me soon! Less

marathon.name: Anchorage
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Anchorage! I'm a fun loving guy that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home. I'm an outgoing guy that loves other cats and dogs so I'm just a purrfect fit. If you think a cool cat like me could be the one for you come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Galaxy *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: My name is Galaxy and I want to be as untamed and free as the universe itself. I'm used to a life on the streets taking care of me, myself and I. I'd be happy to be your barn or shop cat if you'll have me! Less

marathon.name: Terracotta
marathon.bio: HI there, I'm Terracotta! I'm a sweet girl that is here at HSMC as a stray. I'm a great cat that loves attention but can be a little shy until I get to know you! Come visit me soon!* Terracotta is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Terracotta please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visitLess

marathon.name: Sassy
marathon.bio: Where are all of my strong, independent girlies at? My name is Sassy and it fits; I like to keep my inner circle small and would prefer to be your one and only. I've had my fair share of homes and transitions so I'm hoping to find the one that sticks. Adventurous adults are my vibe, small children or dogs that share my home not so much. I know my forever is out there and I just can't wait to find it.

marathon.name: Blu
marathon.bio: Blu is a German Shepherd Dog dog.

marathon.name: Buddy *Bonded Pair*
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Buddy! My best pal, Hannah, and I are here at HSMC looking for our new home! We're a great pair that are both very mellow and quiet. I love to get pets and scritches, and Hannah likes a little more alone time but we sure love each other! You will always catch us snuggling or grooming each other. If you think a gorgeous pair like us could be the one for you come visit me soon! Less

marathon.name: Snapback
marathon.bio: Snapback is an orange or red Domestic Shorthair kitten, 3 mos old.

marathon.name: Hosea *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: If you're looking for a working cat, I'm your guy! My name is Hosea and I'm used to a life on the streets and fending for myself, relying on the kindness of strangers to get by. Don't get me wrong, I still want the independence but I'd like someone lookin' out for me too. I'll gladly call your shop or barn my home and I'm sure we can figure out the rest of the details from there. Less

marathon.name: Stack
marathon.bio: I just can't get why my case is still unsolved? Why am I not adopted yet? I'm Stack and I'm ready and willing to be adopted RIGHT NOW. I can be a little shy, sure, but who isn't when you're meeting strangers. I love other cats and I know I'll soon blossoming into an amazing feline. Please adopt me right now!

marathon.name: Scat Cat
marathon.bio: Shooby dooby bee boop de booo, I'm Scat Cat and I'm ready to be make you love me! I'm a cute little guy that is hoping my forever family will find me real soon! I'm a graduate of the Grandma foster kittens and boy am I ready to take on the world. I'm an active guy that loves to climb, chase, run, and just be the crazy kitten I am! I enjoy other cats and I've even bullied a pug in my short lifetime. But, I better warn you. You leave any dirty clothes around I just might steal them and run off with them! I promise I'll keep you on your toes! Anyways, you better come adopt me before someone else does! Less

marathon.name: Roquefort
marathon.bio: Hit here, I'm Roquefort! And listen, if you don't adopt me you will be missing out on the most amazing cat! I've had a hard start to life, being found on my own on someone's doorstep. I was underweight, underdeveloped and in need of TLC. I was taken to an amazing foster lady named Grandma who spent months getting me healthy and ready to be adopted. And I'm not going to lie, we both cried when we had to say goodbye, but we both agree it is time to find a family of my very own! I'm a mellow cat that loves to be around other cats, and I really love to sit on a little cat tree that preferably is shaped like a flower. I also love to stare at you while you shower, and I will totally NOT steal your dirty clothes unlike my friend Scat Cat. Anyways, if you think a special boy like me could be the one for you then you better come apply for me today! Less

marathon.name: Melly
marathon.bio: Melly is a black Golden Retriever dog, 2 yrs old.

marathon.name: Walrus
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Walrus! I'm a fun loving cat that just can't wait to find my new home! I'm super outgoing, playful and soooo energetic! Come visit me soon! Less

marathon.name: Frosty
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Frosty! I'm a fancy feline that was brought to HSMC as a stray and am now looking for a forever home. I'm super sweet, soft and I love other cats! If you think I could be the cat for you come visit me soon at Wild Birds Unlimited in Rib Mountain. Less

marathon.name: Chewy
marathon.bio: Hey friends! They call me Chewy and tell me that I'm a good boy and I'm sure hoping that you feel the same way, too. I've got beautiful blue eyes, a stubborn streak and the smarts and wit common to my breed. I enjoy spending time outside, playing fetch and singing the songs of my people. I'm tolerant of other dogs but do not want to share treats or high value items. You look like you could be a forever kind of human, let's make my dreams come true!

marathon.name: Sidon
marathon.bio: Hey there, I bet you're wondering who this handsome guy is? Well, I'm Sidon and I'm ready to rock your world! I'm a fun loving guy that is here just waiting and waiting for you to adopt me! You better do so soon! I'm great with other cats and would be excellent in a home with them again! Come visit me soon!* Sidon is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Sidon please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visitLess

marathon.name: Bevvy
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Bevvy! I'm a shy girl here at HSMC that is hoping to find a home to call my very own. Don't be surprised if it takes me a little bit to warm up to you, I haven't always been able to trust humans but the staff here have been showing me that I can. I'm a sweet girl that enjoys being brushed and pet. I especially love a little canned cat food in the morning! Come visit me soon if you think I could be the cat for you! Less

marathon.name: Dolly Purrton
marathon.bio: Dolly Purrton is a gray or blue Domestic Shorthair cat.

marathon.name: Keely
marathon.bio: What has four legs, pointy ears and the biggest brown eyes? ME! They call me Keely and I sure took a gamble by coming to the shelter in search of a new life and a family to adopt. Self esteem isn't one of my strong traits but I've working hard on it. I was adopted once and lived a beautiful life but much to the sadness of myself and my humans, it wasn't meant to be. I'm hoping with who they helped me become and all that I have to offer my new family, I won't have to wait long. Let's make our love story one of the best that's ever been told.

clark.name: Darla (Adoption Fee Sponsored!)
clark.bio: If you're looking for a dog with brains, loyalty, and a heart that's worth earning, meet Darla! Like many Heelers, Darla is incredibly intelligent and loves having a job to do. She's observant, eager to learn, and forms deep bonds with the people she trusts. Once you're part of her circle, you'll discover what a sweet, devoted companion she truly is. Darla can be a little shy when meeting new people and may take some time to warm up—especially around some men—but patience and kindness go a long way. She'll do best with someone who understands that trust isn't rushed, and that watching a timid dog blossom is one of life's greatest rewards. Darla is looking for an adult-only home, as she's not comfortable living with children. In the right environment, with people who respect her boundaries and appreciate her brilliant mind, she's sure to become an incredibly loyal best friend. If you're ready to invest a little time and a lot of love, Darla is ready to show you just how special she is. Darla's adoption fee is sponsored by an anonymous donor!

clark.name: Connie
clark.bio: Connie has already proven she's resilient. After being abandoned in a basement with Reyn and Nana, she never gave up hope that someone would come. Today, Connie is ready to leave that chapter behind and start writing a new one filled with adventures, belly rubs, sniff-filled walks, and the unconditional love every dog deserves. She's a classic coonhound with a gentle heart and an incredible capacity to forgive. Connie is searching for a family that will cherish her, celebrate her progress, and remind her every single day that she'll never be left behind again. She's waited long enough for her happily ever after—could it be with you? Their Adoption fee is sponsored.

clark.name: Reyn
clark.bio: Reyns' story didn't begin the way every dog deserves. She, along with Connie and Nana, were abandoned and left behind in a basement, relying only on each other until help finally arrived. Despite everything, Reyn hasn't let her past steal her future. She's a sweet, gentle soul whos ready to discover what it means to be someones beloved companion. Whether its following her nose on a leisurely walk, soaking up attention, or simply enjoying the comfort of a warm bed, Reyn is ready for the life shes always deserved. Shes looking for a family that understands trust takes time, but knows the reward of watching a dogs confidence bloom is worth every moment. Reyn has survived the hardest chapter of her life—now shes ready for the happiest one.

clark.name: Nana
clark.bio: For too long, Nana's world was limited to four basement walls. Abandoned alongside her companions, Reyn and Connie, she waited patiently for someone to find her—and thankfully, that day finally came. Now Nana is getting the chance to experience all the things every dog should know: kindness, security, soft beds, full bellies, and people who wont leave her behind. She's a beautiful coonhound with so much love still waiting to give to the right family. Nana doesn't need a perfect home—she just needs one that's patient, understanding, and ready to show her that forever really can mean forever. If you're looking for a loyal friend whose best days are still ahead, Nana is waiting to meet you!

clark.name: Teller
clark.bio: Meet Teller, a brilliant young dog with a thoughtful heart and a story that's led her right back to us through no fault of her own. At just 10 months old, this Rat Terrier and Cattle Dog mix already shows off her impressive intelligence and communication skills. She even knows how to use a button to let you know when she needs to go potty! Teller was originally adopted but sadly returned due to changes in her owner's circumstances. Because of that, she can be a little slow to trust when meeting new people and adjusting to new environments. She likes to take her time observing the world and figuring out who feels safe. But once Teller decides you're her person, she truly shines. She becomes a deeply loyal, affectionate, and devoted companion who sticks close and bonds hard. Her smart, attentive nature makes her an incredible partner for someone willing to give her patience and consistency. With her mix of brains, sensitivity, and heart, Teller will thrive in a calm, understanding home that lets her open up at her own pace. In return, she offers one of the most rewarding bonds you can ask for. Teller isn't just looking for a home, but is looking for someone to trust completely.

clark.name: Sam
clark.bio: Sam is a handsome 60-pound mixed-breed boy who came to us as a stray, and he's ready to find the loving family he deserves! This sweet, young pup has a heart as big as his smile. Sam absolutely loves playing fetch and will happily chase after a ball as many times as you're willing to throw it. When playtime is over, he's more than happy to soak up all the attention and affection you can give. Belly rubs, pets, and spending time with his people are at the top of his favorite things list. Sam's playful personality and loving nature make him a wonderful companion for someone looking for an active best friend who also enjoys plenty of cuddles. Since he came to us as a stray, we're still getting to know everything about him, but one thing is already clear—he's an incredibly sweet boy who can't wait to find a place to call home. If you're looking for a loyal companion who's always up for a game of fetch and lots of love, Sam might just be your perfect match!

clark.name: Biggie
clark.bio: Biggie may have arrived as a stray, but hes quickly showing that underneath his unsure first impressions is a big-hearted dog just waiting for the right person to help him feel safe. At around 4 years old, Biggie is past the puppy chaos but still has plenty of life, love, and personality to share. He can be a little skittish when meeting new people or experiencing new environments, but give him a bit of time and patience and youll see the transformation-soft eyes, relaxed body language, and a whole lot of affection. Once Biggie trusts you, he leans in hard for love. He enjoys gentle attention, reassurance, and simply being near his person. Hes the kind of dog who bonds deeply and becomes incredibly loyal once he knows hes safe. Biggie will do best in a calm, patient home that understands he may need a little time to decompress and adjust. In return, he offers a big personality, a big heart, and a whole lot of love just waiting to come out. If youre looking for a diamond-in-the-ruff who just needs someone to believe in him, Biggie might be your guy.

clark.name: Bowie
clark.bio: Bowie is one seriously entertaining puppy! This adorable terrier mix is energetic, playful, curious, and just a little bit crazy—in the absolute best puppy way. Bowie loves being part of the action and has never met a game he didnt want to join. Hes got plenty of puppy zoomies, plenty of goofy antics, and plenty of opinions to share. His terrier personality shines through in his confidence, enthusiasm, and determination to investigate everything around him. Bowie is looking for a family ready to embrace puppyhood in all its chaotic glory and help him grow into the wonderful dog hes meant to be. With training, exercise, and lots of love, this goofy guy is going to make someone a fantastic companion!

clark.name: Hendrix
clark.bio: Hendrix is a little terrier mix with a rockstar personality! He is energetic, playful, goofy, and always ready to turn the volume up to eleven. Like any good terrier puppy, Hendrix is curious about EVERYTHING. He loves to play, explore, wrestle, zoom around, and generally make sure there is never a dull moment. He's got a fun-loving personality and plenty of puppy energy that will need an outlet through play, exercise, training, and enrichment. If your idea of the perfect puppy includes a little bit of chaos, a lot of laughs, and an adorable face you can't resist, Hendrix could be your next best friend!

clark.name: Primrose
clark.bio: Prim is a gentle, fluffy sweetheart looking for a forever home. She may be experiencing many things for the very first time, but she's ready to learn with the help of a loving family. Whether its playtime, cuddle time, or learning new tricks, Prim is excited for every adventure ahead.

clark.name: Peeta
clark.bio: Meet Peeta! This sweet little guy recently arrived at the shelter with his siblings after being rescued from an Amish property. Like any puppy, hes full of curiosity, playful energy, and is ready to discover the world! Peeta is looking for a family that will help him learn all about house training, basic manners, and how wonderful life as a beloved family member can be.

clark.name: Johanna
clark.bio: Johanna is a spunky little pup with lots of personality! This fluffy girl is looking for a family thats ready for all the fun that comes with raising a puppy. With love, patience, and guidance, Johanna is sure to grow into an incredible companion.

clark.name: Haymitch
clark.bio: Haymitch is a playful little adventurer who is ready to trade farm life for family life! Rescued alongside his siblings, hes just beginning to experience all the exciting sights, sounds, and comforts the world has to offer. With patience, love, and plenty of treats, Haymitch is sure to grow into a loyal lifelong companion.

clark.name: Gale
clark.bio: Gale is an adventurous little guy with a bright future ahead of him. Rescued with his siblings, he's looking for a family to show him what love, security, and a forever home are all about. Like all puppies, he'll thrive with training, socialization, and lots of playtime.

clark.name: Cinna
clark.bio: Cinna is as sweet as they come! This adorable Heeler/Chow mix puppy is learning that people can be pretty amazing. He enjoys playing, exploring, and soaking up attention whenever he can. If you're ready for all the fun (and a little chaos!) that comes with raising a puppy, Cinna can't wait to meet you.

clark.name: Tina
clark.bio: Tina may be little, but she certainly doesnt act like it! This adorable terrier mix is energetic, hilarious, and full of the kind of puppy confidence that makes you wonder how something so small can create so much chaos. Tina loves to play, investigate, wrestle, and keep up with the action. She has that classic terrier personality—busy, bold, entertaining, and not afraid to let you know exactly what she thinks. Shes still a puppy, so shell need a family ready for the zoomies, puppy antics, training, and occasional mischief that come along with raising a young dog. Tina is ready to find a family who will love her big personality as much as we do!

clark.name: Jagger
clark.bio: Meet Jagger, a little terrier mix with a BIG personality! While he's supposedly an Aussie/terrier mix, Jagger definitely seems to have taken after his terrier side. He's energetic, curious, goofy, and always ready to turn absolutely anything into an adventure. Jagger is the kind of puppy who believes life is one giant game. He loves to explore, play, wrestle with his siblings, and make sure everyone knows when he has something important to say. He's got plenty of puppy energy and would love an active family who will give him lots of playtime, attention, training, and opportunities to be a silly puppy. If you're looking for a fun-loving little troublemaker with a whole lot of personality packed into one adorable body, Jagger might be your guy!

clark.name: Marlin
clark.bio: Meet Marlin! Marlin is a handsome black boy who is ready to leave his little ocean of siblings and discover what life is like with a family of his very own! With his fluffy coat, sweet face, and lovable puppy nature, Marlin is hard to resist. Hes at that wonderful puppy stage where everything is interesting — new people, new smells, new toys, new places, and especially anything that might possibly be edible. Marlin will need a family who understands that raising a puppy is an adventure of its own. Hell need patience, consistency, training, socialization, and plenty of opportunities to play and burn off that puppy energy. In return, youll get to watch him grow from an adorable little fluffball into your loyal best friend. His Chow/Aussie mix heritage means he may grow into a clever, energetic dog who loves having a job to do and being part of the family. Marlin has spent his early days looking out for his siblings. Now hes hoping someone will choose him and make sure hes never lost again.

clark.name: Ozzy
clark.bio: Ozzy is a little wild man with a serious talent for making people laugh! This terrier mix is energetic, goofy, loud, playful, and always ready for his next adventure. Ozzy has that unmistakable terrier personality. He's curious, busy, enthusiastic, and absolutely loves to play. Whether he's wrestling with a sibling, zooming around, investigating something suspicious, or making his opinions known, Ozzy knows how to keep things interesting! He's looking for a family who will give him plenty of exercise, enrichment, training, and love while he grows into his big personality. If you want a puppy who will keep you laughing and never let life get boring, Ozzy is your guy!

clark.name: Lennon
clark.bio: Lennon is a goofy little terrier mix who is always ready for fun! Hes energetic, playful, curious, and has absolutely no shortage of puppy personality. Lennon loves to run, wrestle, explore, and join in on whatever his siblings are doing. He has the classic terrier enthusiasm and can be delightfully loud when he feels like sharing his thoughts with the world. Hes still young and learning, so his future family should be prepared for plenty of puppy energy, training, chewing, zoomies, and general silliness. With the right family, Lennon will have everything he needs to grow into a happy, well-rounded companion—and hes sure to provide plenty of laughs along the way!

clark.name: Stefan
clark.bio: Stefan is proof that being sweet never goes out of style. This adorable little guy has a gentle soul wrapped up in an irresistibly cute puppy package. He enjoys exploring at his own pace, wrestling with his siblings, and handing out plenty of tail wags to everyone he meets. Curious but thoughtful, playful but affectionate, Stefan is the perfect mix of adventure buddy and cuddle companion. He's ready to trade Mystic Falls for a forever home where he can grow into your very best friend.

clark.name: Matt
clark.bio: No supernatural powers here—just one really great puppy. Matt may be the "human" of the group, but he's every bit as lovable as his famous namesake. He's easygoing, friendly, and always up for whatever the day brings. Whether that's chasing a tennis ball, making new dog friends, or relaxing after a busy day of puppy adventures, Matt is happiest when he's spending time with his people. He's the kind of pup who doesn't need to be the center of attention to win your heart... although he probably will anyway.

clark.name: Damon
clark.bio: Let's be honest—Damon knows he's handsome. With those irresistible puppy eyes and a mischievous grin, this little guy has already mastered the "I definitely didn't do anything wrong" look. He's curious, confident, and always ready to see what kind of fun the day has in store. Whether it's wrestling with his siblings, chasing toys twice his size, or convincing you he deserves one more treat, Damon is all in. Don't let the swagger fool you, though. Once playtime is over, this little heart-stealer is more than happy to soak up all the cuddles he can get.

clark.name: Morris (Bonded with Myrtle)
clark.bio: Morris is a 14-week-old Domestic Shorthair with a friendly personality and plenty of kitten curiosity! He loves to explore, investigate his surroundings, and turn just about anything into a new adventure. When he isn’t busy playing, Morris is a sweet and cuddly little guy who loves attention and affection. He has the perfect mix of playful kitten energy and snuggly sweetness. Morris is bonded with his sister, Myrtle, and these two best friends are looking for a forever home together. If you have room in your heart for double the love, Morris and Myrtle are ready to meet you!

clark.name: Caroline
clark.bio: If sunshine had four paws, it would probably look a lot like Caroline. This sweet girl has perfected the art of making everyone fall in love with her in record time. She's equal parts playful explorer, professional cuddle expert, and full-time collector of compliments. Like her namesake, Caroline has a way of stealing the spotlight without even trying. Whether she's zooming through the yard, investigating every leaf she can find, or curling up for a well-earned puppy nap, she does it with undeniable charm. She's looking for a family ready for adventures, belly rubs, and a lifetime of unconditional love.

clark.name: Janis
clark.bio: Janis is a little terrier mix with a personality that is impossible to ignore! She's energetic, goofy, playful, and just the right amount of crazy. Janis loves puppy playtime and has no problem keeping up with the rest of the crew. She's curious about her surroundings, enthusiastic about pretty much everything, and has plenty of that classic terrier confidence. She's also not afraid to use her voice when she has something to say! Janis is looking for a family ready for the fun and responsibility of puppyhood. She'll need continued training, socialization, exercise, and lots of appropriate ways to burn off her endless puppy energy. In exchange, she'll bring a whole lot of laughter, love, and personality to her new home!

clark.name: Alex
clark.bio: Alex is an adorable Aussie/American Eskimo mix born June 22, 2026, and he is one fluffy little ball of puppy fun! This handsome boy has the classic puppy personality—playful, energetic, curious, and always ready for his next adventure. Alex loves exploring his surroundings, playing with his littermates, and soaking up attention. Hes fluffy, goofy, and absolutely irresistible! Like any young puppy, hell need plenty of patience, playtime, training, and love as he learns how to be the very best companion.

clark.name: Isaac
clark.bio: Meet Isaac, a ridiculously cute Aussie/American Eskimo mix born June 22, 2026! With his fluffy coat and adorable puppy face, hes hard to resist. Isaac is a typical happy, energetic puppy who loves to play, investigate everything around him, and get into a little puppy mischief. He enjoys romping around with his littermates and is always ready for some fun. Hell make a wonderful companion for someone ready to keep up with puppy energy and help him learn and grow!

adams.name: Pika
adams.bio: My adoption fee is only $25 for the month of July! The first thing people notice about Pika is that she is a senior cat, but once you meet her and she has warmed up to you, you'd never believe it. This sweet girl has had a rough life so far and she wears her fear in her gaze. She takes a fair bit to warm up, but she is learning what love is every day. She still gets scared and is easily overstimulated, so she would need someone patient and calm who will not overwhelm her as she continues to open up. She enjoys gentle belly rubs, pets on her head and shoulders (NOT her rump!), and being spoken to with soothing words of encouragement. She will give affectionate headbutts and even enjoys the rare kiss on her noggin. She is known to lash out when startled, overwhelmed, or overstimulated, but is otherwise a very gentle sweetheart. She just needs someone who will respect her peace as she overcomes years of trauma and learns how to trust. Is that somebody you? Less

I'm friendly, gentle, and learning to walk well on a leash. I come as part of a bonded pair with my shy friend Ziggy, so you'll get double the love and companionship! I would do best in an adult-only home where I can thrive and help Ziggy work on his confidence. Come meet us and discover why we're the perfect package for you!

fetch.name: Gretzky
fetch.bio: Ello again...In case you forgot, I'm Gretzky. I've been in foster care for a long time now and I've really got a good schedule down. I'll tell you about it if you want....First I wake up and am excited to go potty outside. It's one of my favorite times and I may bark or nip your butt with excitement. Don't worry, I'm not /that/ excited. I just really have to pee. Then I come inside and lay on my beddy. It's my favorite spot. Unfortunately, I'm what my foster calls 'a babe magnet.' This means my canine and feline roommates will come to snuggle in my beddy with me, even in very warm temperatures. I don't understand it either. So we spend the next several hours rotating beddies until lunch, when we go back outside. Much sleeping is had. And snacks. Then the garage door opens and my room mates and I loose our collective minds because foster M'mam is home! I love her. And it means we get to do the best thing ever: walkies. I love pooping when I'm on a leash. I love walking. I don't need to smell anything, I don't care. I just like to walk. Especially in the woods! Sometimes we will see people on our walk. It makes me very nervous. Sometimes they will ask to pet me. I tell them 'No Thank You' by desperately trying to get away from them. Then I am edgy the rest of the walk. What if they secretly pop out of a bush to pet me?? Sometimes my foster M'mam will lock me in the bathroom and pet me. I've gotten used to this strange habit, but I don't really like it. fetch.name: Chuck
fetch.bio: Meet Chuck — the best Chuck you’ll ever know. You’ve heard of Chuck Norris, Chuck Berry, and Chuck E. Cheese… but none of them can hold a candle to this guy. Chuck spent his early life working as a breeder, and now he’s finally ready to trade that in for belly rubs, car rides, and a real home to call his own. This sweet boy loves cruising with the windows down, playing outside, getting his ears scratched, and curling up in a cozy bed at the end of the day. Because he’s still learning the ropes of just being a dog, Chuck would love a canine sibling to show him how it’s done (and to be his new best friend).Chuck is great with kids, and while we haven’t tested the waters with cats yet, he’s such an easygoing guy that we think he’d do just fine. If you’re ready for your next adventure buddy, just remember one

fetch.name: Fortune
fetch.bio: As Fortune approaches two years in foster care, everyone who knows him is asking the same question: How has this wonderful boy not been adopted yet? Fortune is a sweet, gentle Great Pyrenees mix who's simply looking for a patient family willing to give him the time he needs to feel safe. Once he trusts you, you'll have one of the most loyal companions you could ask for. Fortune is truly an easy dog to live with. He's fully potty trained, dog-door trained, and non-destructive when left home alone. He settles into a routine beautifully and asks for very little—just a safe place, a little patience, and someone to love. One of Fortune's favorite activities is going for walks, and he's an absolute gentleman on a leash. He also loves car rides, making him the perfect road trip companion. At home, you'll often find him relaxing in the sunshine or happily patrolling the yard, always keeping an eye out for squirrels, rabbits, and other critters. When he feels safe, he loves to run and explore, so a securely fenced yard is required. Fortune enjoys being brushed, does well during baths, and settles nicely in his kennel. With his low-to-medium energy level, he's just as happy lounging around the house as he is exploring the backyard. Fortune is shy, especially around men, and needs adopters who understand that trust takes time. He'll thrive with a family that allows him to adjust at his own pace and celebrates the little victories along the way. Watching him gain confidence is incredibly rewa

fetch.name: Russell
fetch.bio: I’M FREE! After 10 months in a small cage, I’m finally out and learning what it means to be a puppy. WOOHOO!I’m Russell, and I’m ready to make up for lost time. I’m looking for an active, patient family with another dog to run and play with — bonus points for a fenced yard where I can really let loose. I’m doing great with house training, and I’m working on my leash manners and getting comfortable in my crate. Now that I’ve discovered toys (and, okay, also magazines ), I’m all about chewing, playing, and exploring everything I missed out on. I’ve got a lot of energy and I’m eager to learn — I just need you to help me burn it off with walks, runs, and plenty of stimulation. Think we could be a match? Apply for me — I’m Russell, and I can’t wait to meet you! You can apply for me at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Turbo
fetch.bio: Meet Turbo Say hello to Turbo, a sweet 8-year-old Plott Hound who is ready to find a family of her very own! Turbo is a loving/sometimes playful/gentle/goofy pup who loves - walks, snuggling on the couch under a blanket, or just hanging out wherever you are. She is happiest when she is outside just soaking up some sun or in your bed with you at night. Her foster mom says, Turbo has been great. We have been working on counter surfing and barking. She is house-trained/crate-trained and leash-trained, but we have been working on that too as she is a hound and she likes to pull, which is understandable as they were bred to hunt after all. She is not fond of car rides, but loves to go in the car. She would do great with dogs/kids. Not sure about cats. Like every dog, Turbo has her own unique personality and may need a little time, patience, and encouragement while settling into a new home. But once she feels comfortable, she’ll reward you with plenty of love and loyalty. If you’re looking for a bed partner/goofy/loving companion who will be your best friend, Turbo might just be the one! Interested in giving Turbo a forever home? Apply to adopt and come meet this wonderful pup! You can apply for this pup at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Twinkle
fetch.bio: Meet Twinkle Twinkle is a sweet girl who is just beginning her journey of discovering what it's like to be a beloved family pet. She is learning that the world can be a safe and happy place filled with belly rubs, couches to lay on, and lots of love. Twinkle is making great progress with house and potty training and will thrive with a patient family willing to continue helping her learn. She is still coming out of her shell is a little shy at first, but every day she becomes a little more confident. One thing Twinkle knows for sure is that she loves other dogs! Her happiest moments are spent running, playing, and exploring outside. A secure fenced yard is her dream, and having another playful, confident dog in the home would help her continue to build confidence and show her the ropes. Twinkle currently lives with children and is doing well with them. Because she is still learning to trust and adjust to family life, she will need an understanding home that will let her settle in at her own pace. If you're looking for a gentle soul to nurture and watch blossom into the dog she was always meant to be, Twinkle may be the perfect addition to your family. With patience, love, and a canine companion by her side, this special girl is sure to shine. Twinkle's Ideal Home:Another friendly, playful dog (unknown on how she is with cats)A secure fenced yardA patient family willing to continue her training and socializationA loving home that understands she may need time to adjust and potty tr

fetch.name: Daisy
fetch.bio: Hi, we're Daisy and Bella. We have found ourselves being surrendered to rescue because our parents had to go to assisted living. We were very well cared for and loved! Therfore, we would LOVE a home together if possible. We do well with older children, and we even have cats at our foster home! We like to play with our foster siblings and LOVE walks. We'd love a home where we can cuddle or chill on the couch with you. No worries leaving us at home, Daisy will even give you her biggest smile when you return! You can apply for us at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Scooter (9)
fetch.bio: Meet Scooter! This handsome 1-year-old Beagle is looking for a patient adopter who will give him the time he needs to feel safe and loved. While he can be a little shy when meeting new people, especially men, once he trusts you, his sweet personality shines through. He'll happily follow you around the house, snuggle up for cuddles, and become your loyal best friend. Scooter loves being outdoors and enjoys walks, though his Beagle nose occasionally leads him on little sniffing adventures. He rides great in the car, is doing wonderfully with pottying outside, and gets along well with his two foster Beagle sisters. Once he's comfortable in his surroundings, he loves to play and have fun. Because he can be nervous around unfamiliar people, particularly men, he'll need a patient family that understands trust takes time. He may initially growl when a man enters the room, but with gentle, calm interactions and patience, he continues to make progress and will even accept pets when he's feeling comfortable. If you're willing to let this sweet boy move at his own pace, you'll be rewarded with a devoted companion who just wants a person to call his own. can apply for this pup at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Mocha
fetch.bio: Miss Mocha is 100% a family girl because this girl LOVES her people. Her previous family had 10 kids and it's clear she must have been great with them because she's a lover for sure. Mocha is a Chesapeake Bay Retriever whose main purpose was to have puppies. Then when it came time for her previous family to move, they had no intention of taking Mocha with. While she may have lost the family she loved, she is very much enjoying the good life while living in her foster home and waiting for her forever family to find her. Mocha seems to be house trained, is good with cats, kids, and really, any size humans. Her current foster home has a lot of dogs, so they are taking it slow to ensure everyone gets along and it's going well. If you're looking for a great family dog, you might as well apply now cause this girl would make a great addition! You can apply for this pup at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Bud
fetch.bio: **COURTESY POST**Hi, I’m Bud! I’m a 2-year-old American Akita mix, tipping the scales at 59 lbs of love. Life dealt me a rough hand when my last owner abandoned me, but some wonderful people took me in and gave me a fresh start. I’m getting settled in and I’m ready to find my forever home! A little about me: I’m neutered, up to date on my vaccines, and microchipped — my new humans took great care of me I LOVE playing catch and I’ll happily play with any toy you hand me I’m a total snuggle bug — I crave affection and just want to be near my people I do well with other dogs and love to play, though I’m still working on my manners around cats and cows (a fenced yard would help me stay out of trouble!) I’m currently learning leash manners with my harnessSince my current family is helping me heal, I’ll come to you with all my vet records, my microchip info, and even a Fi Mini GPS tracker, so you can always find me. I’m hoping to find my forever humans soon — the kind who’ll give me space to run, love to give, and patience while I learn the ropes. If you think we might be a match, please fill out an application today! Located in Hatley, Wisconsin. You can apply for me at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Cookie
fetch.bio: Meet Cookie – Your Future Best Friend! Hi, I’m Cookie, and I’ve come such a long way since entering foster care! I’ve been working hard to learn all the things that make me the perfect companion—I’m fully potty trained, can do stairs like a pro, and have mastered the art of couch and bed snuggles. I absolutely adore my foster mom and hate being away from her, so I know I’ll form a strong bond with my forever family, too. I’m still learning to trust new people, and sometimes I clam up in unfamiliar situations—but I promise, if you believe in me like my foster mom does, I’ll show you my HUGE, dorky, lovable personality! I’m looking for a patient and understanding home that will continue helping me build confidence. In return, I’ll give you unconditional love, endless tail wags, and a lifetime of loyalty. Could you be the one to give me my happily ever after? Apply to adopt me today! You can apply for me at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

southwood.name: Adam *Diabetic, In Foster*
southwood.bio: Adam is a handsome senior gentleman that would love a forever home to relax, unwind, and receive lots of love and give it in return! Adam was brought to us as a stray, and we soon realized that Adam was dealing with unmanaged diabetes. Adam has responded to his insulin very well and is back on track, and is ready for a home that is willing to help him be healthy and happy! Adam needs to be on a low-carb diet (this is easy, and we can give you a list of good foods that ARE NOT expensive!) and he also needs to eat only twice a day, and receive his insulin 30 minutes after each meal. Because his diabetes went unmanaged for an unknown length of time before he arrived to us, he does walk a bit flat on his back legs. This has gotten better now that his diabetes is managed, but he may always walk a little funny. Adam uses the litter box just fine and has no issues! He is an older gentleman though, and may need some minor help with grooming and brushing. Adam is so, so sweet and has so much love to give - please consider letting him into your heart and he will love you back tenfold! Less

southwood.name: Sharpie
southwood.bio: Hi! My name is Sharpie! I’m a 1-year-old kitty who came to the shelter as a transfer from another humane society. I’m a sweet girl, but I’m also an independent kitty who enjoys having my own space and some quiet time to myself. I like being able to relax and do my own thing, but I have plenty of love to give when I’m ready for attention! I’m not sure yet how I feel about other animals, but we can take things slowly and figure it out together. I’m looking for a patient family who will respect my space and let my personality shine at my own pace. If you’re looking for a sweet, independent kitty with a personality all her own, come meet me! Less

southwood.name: Coral
southwood.bio: Meet Coral! Hi there! My name is Coral, and I’m a sweet 1-year-old girl who is ready to find my forever home! I was found as a stray, and now I’m hoping my next chapter will be filled with love, cuddles, and a family of my own. I absolutely love attention and am always happy to spend time with my people! While I’m not the biggest fan of being picked up, I do love a good cuddle when I’m comfortable. I’ll happily show you that I can be affectionate without needing to be carried around. I’m not quite sure yet how I feel about other animals, so I’ll need some patience and slow introductions while we figure that out together. If you’re looking for a sweet, affectionate companion who loves attention and knows exactly how she likes to be loved, I might just be your perfect match! Less

southwood.name: Hei Hei
southwood.bio: Meet Hei Hei! Hi there! My name is Hei Hei, and I’m an adorable 2-month-old kitten looking for my forever home! I came to the Humane Society as a stray with my siblings, Pua, Tomatoa, and Maui, along with our mom, Moana. I’m still just a little kitten, which means I have so much growing, exploring, and learning ahead of me! I’m ready to find a loving family who will give me plenty of attention, playtime, cozy naps, and all the love a kitten could ask for. I may be small right now, but I’m ready to fill your home with lots of fun, curiosity, and kitten adventures! Less

southwood.name: Zara
southwood.bio: Meet Zara! Zara is a beautiful 4-year-old mixed breed girl with a heart full of sunshine and a love for the great outdoors. If there’s fresh air involved, Zara is happy!
